scope.integration: Standalone asset and playable review pack; integration remains with the game maintainer.

authorship.art: Original procedural meshes, animation curves, icons and VFX contracts; no third-party game art, branding, or captured movement.

coordinates.tileOrigin: near port z=0; far port z=30; grounded surface y=0 at both ports

clips.name: jump_rise
clips.contactPolicy: continuous authored jump with takeoff, apex hold and landing segmented across three clips

clips.name: jump_apex
clips.contactPolicy: continuous authored jump with takeoff, apex hold and landing segmented across three clips

clips.name: jump_land
clips.contactPolicy: continuous authored jump with takeoff, apex hold and landing segmented across three clips

rootPolicy.lateral: lane clips are in-place; runtime translates lane centers
rootPolicy.vertical: Root owns the complete vertical jump arc; Hips owns ground support correction. Runtime must not add a second jump displacement.

transitions.recovery: All fall variations -> get_up with 0.18 s crossfade. get_up starts in forward-fall pose and finishes at glide.

ports.continuity: C1 position and tangent; all 64 ordered tile pairs compatible

preview.network: HTTP server needed for modules and GLB fetch; all runtime resources local, no external requests.

input.touch: swipe in four directions or use icon buttons

qa.jumpScoring: jump_rise + jump_apex + jump_land sampled as a single continuous action. Individual airborne phase diagnostics are retained and are not passing standalone scores.
qa.phonePerformance: Not measured; software Chromium checks are functional evidence.
